display_title: The Cure for an Arrogant Boss
description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61126677), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%98%A4%EB%A7%8C%ED%95%9C-%EC%82%AC%EC%9E%A5%EB%8B%98%EC%9D%98-%EC%B9%98%EB%A3%8C%EB%B2%95/3282)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/152048)

Nahyun had a great time with a man she met by chance while traveling alone in Spain. However, he was a man from a chaebol family. A chaebol like the father who abandoned her mother. So she ran away and thought they would never meet again.

“Did you really think I wouldn’t find you?”

This man was appointed as the president of the company Nahyeon works for.

“The only thing I don’t know about you is why you’re running away from me.”

A cohabitation that began with a relationship made in Spain, and a fatal office romance.
